# 14 · Three-Year Award History Automation

Every ten minutes: enrol all stored real notices missing current coverage, then refresh at most one eligible notice. Backend owns durable claims, retry backoff, freshness, three-year history and opening bidders/scores. All 700 daily API requests are guarded by the backend; each notice reserves at most 150.

Manual execution runs a synthetic offline fixture with zero network calls. Scheduled execution uses only protected award operations. Generic Header Auth is inherited from the approved W10 backend credential by exact name/type. No AI, analysis, Teams or direct provider calls exist here. Emergency switch: PAI_LOOP_EMERGENCY_DISABLE=true.

HTTP timeout 520 seconds; no retry or redirect. Responses are validated against an aggregate allowlist; identifiers and source rows are never emitted. Backend persists the audit and progress; n8n execution payload storage is disabled.
